units.text: Look from one eye to the other in a mirror. Why can't you normally catch the movement?

units.text: Now record your eyes, and watch it back. There it is.

units.text: Each quick jump is a saccade.

units.text: As they turn, the image sweeps across the retina.

units.text: The clear views before and after can also mask the brief blur.

units.text: You aren't completely blind. These effects help keep vision stable.

units.text: The mirror never stopped showing it. Your visual system normally keeps the sweep out of awareness.
